CamelBak Chute Mag Water Bottle with Magnetic Leak‑Resistant Cap

$11.99
The CamelBak Chute Mag is the water bottle that fixes the one thing that annoyed you about every other bottle — the cap. The magnetic cap snaps open and stays out of the way while you drink, then snaps shut when you're done. It's leak-proof even when tossed sideways in a backpack, and the Tritan material is lightweight and BPA-free without the weight of stainless steel. The 25oz size fits most car cup holders and backpack side pockets, and the wide mouth makes it easy to add ice cubes. It's a great alternative to the Owala if you prefer a classic bottle design — and at $12, it's a no-brainer for staying hydrated on campus.
